sources.title: phate334/Breeze-ASR-25-ct2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the conversion of MediaTek-Research/Breeze-ASR-25 to the CTranslate2 model format. This model can be used in CTranslate2 or projects based on CTranslate2 such as faster-whisper.

sources.title: Breeze ASR 25 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Breeze ASR 25 is an advanced ASR model fine-tuned from Whisper-large-v2 Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin Adopted an unified mix embedding for decoding, optimized for Mandarin-English code-switching scenarios, including intra-sentential switching and inter-sentential switching. Enhanced time alignment, suitable for automatic captioning
